Operations addressed by `{entity_type}` and a short code, so they work uniformly across the five families.

## relationships

### `POST /api/relationships`

Create a relationship edge, or a proposal of a `blocks` edge.

The link rule applies (COLLIERY-T-0228). The caller can edit the source
or the target. A `blocks` edge needs the target, the blocked item
(KAIROS-T-0569). A caller who can edit the source only gets a proposal
of the edge. The answer is 202 with the proposal. The message says who
can confirm it (KAIROS-A-0060).

The T-0013 graph
service enforces the A-0001 type-rule matrix, cycle prevention for
`parent`/`blocks`, and duplicate detection — each rejection is a 422
with its typed reason (module docs).

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | no | `string`, nullable | Optional. A key that you choose for this write: 8 to 128 characters of letters, digits, '.', '_', ':' and '-' (a UUID is a good key). Send it when you may retry the request. For 24 hours, a request with the same key and the same arguments writes nothing and gives the first status and body again, with the header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. The same key with other arguments is refused with REQUEST_KEY_REUSED (KAIROS-A-0065). |

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`CreateRelationshipRequest`](../schemas/#createrelationshiprequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | [`Relationship`](../schemas/#relationship) | Edge created (relationship_add activity row written) |
| `202` | [`ProposedRelationship`](../schemas/#proposedrelationship) | No edge: a proposal of a blocks edge. The caller can edit the source only. The message says who can confirm it |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | The caller may edit neither the source nor the target |
| `409` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | CONFLICT: the same proposal is pending, or the item has too many pending proposals; or REQUEST_KEY_REUSED: the Idempotency-Key was used for a different request |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Rule violation, cycle, duplicate edge, or unknown endpoint |

### `DELETE /api/relationships/{id}`

Remove a relationship edge by id.

The link rule applies (COLLIERY-T-0228), as for the create.

The `supports` edge of a document has a rule of its own
(COLLIERY-T-0235). The caller must be able to edit the document. Each
document has an owner board (COLLIERY-T-3109). So the last `supports`
edge of a document can go.

Goes
through the T-0013 unlink service so the `relationship_remove`
activity row is written.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | Relationship edge id (UUID) |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`DeletedResponse`](../schemas/#deletedresponse) | Edge removed |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | The caller may edit neither the source nor the target. For the supports edge of a document: the caller may not edit the document |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | No such edge |

### `GET /api/{entity_type}/{short_code}/children-progress`

Direct-children progress rollup for one item (KAIROS-T-0080): the
`parent`-edge children grouped by their board column, plus the
`(done, total)` summary. Supports/informs material never counts;
resolution 404s exactly like the relationships GET.

**An archived child counts by the column that it was archived from**
(KAIROS-T-0571). A child archived from a done column counts as done,
or as cancelled with the cancel mark. So "Archive completed" keeps the
progress of an initiative. A child archived from another column is in
`removed`. It is not open work, and it is not in `total` or in
`by_column`.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `entity_type` | path | yes | `string` | Entity family (plural URL segment) |
| `short_code` | path | yes | `string` | The parent item's short code |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`ChildrenProgressResponse`](../schemas/#childrenprogressresponse) | The rollup |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown short code |

### `GET /api/{entity_type}/{short_code}/graph`

The focal subgraph (KAIROS-T-0088): every node within `depth` hops
over any relationship type in either direction, plus ALL edges among
the returned nodes — the wire contract the graph view draws from.
Open tenant-wide like the other graph reads.

**Archived nodes are drawn, marked** with `archived_at`
(KAIROS-T-0158). The explorer and the relationships panel render the
same edges, and ADR-20 warns that a half-applied visibility rule is
worse than none — a node listed in the panel and missing from the
picture invites the reader to trust whichever they saw last. Omitting
them also broke paths that merely passed THROUGH archived work: the
walk hops over `item_relationships` directly, so the far side stayed
in the node set with its connecting node deleted out of the middle.

**The mark `done: true` shows a node in a terminal column**
(COLLIERY-T-0233, the rule of COLLIERY-T-0214). A `blocks` edge with a
done node at one end is history, not a blocker. The graph keeps the
edge, and the client draws it with a different style.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `entity_type` | path | yes | `string` | Entity family (plural URL segment) |
| `short_code` | path | yes | `string` | The focal item's short code |
| `depth` | query | no | `integer` | Hop bound; defaults to 2, capped at MAX_TRAVERSE_DEPTH. |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`GraphResponse`](../schemas/#graphresponse) | The focal subgraph |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown family or short code |

### `PUT /api/{entity_type}/{short_code}/parent`

Set the parent of an initiative or a task, or remove it with `null`
(KAIROS-T-0572). An item has one parent. The new edge replaces the old
one in one transaction, so no reader sees two parents.

The link rule applies to each edge that changes (COLLIERY-T-0228). The
caller may edit the item, or the parent at that end. The same parent
again changes nothing (`changed: false`). Kairos refuses a retired code
of the item. A retired code of the parent finds its item
(KAIROS-T-0560). The move rules do not apply: a change of parent is not
a move (KAIROS-A-0040 decision 7).

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `entity_type` | path | yes | `string` | initiatives or tasks |
| `short_code` | path | yes | `string` | The item's short code |

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`SetParentRequest`](../schemas/#setparentrequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`SetParentResponse`](../schemas/#setparentresponse) | The parent now and before; `changed` is false when nothing changed |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | The caller may edit neither the item nor the parent at an end that changes |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown family or short code |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | No `parent` key, a type with no parent, an unknown or archived parent, RELATIONSHIP_RULE, or PARENT_EXISTS (a write at the same time set a parent) |

### `GET /api/{entity_type}/{short_code}/relationships`

All relationships of an item, both directions, grouped by type (open
tenant-wide read; hydrated through `entity_directory`).

**Archived neighbours are included, marked** with `archived_at`
(KAIROS-T-0158, ADR-20). They used to drop out of the hydrating join,
which made this endpoint answer "what does this item contain / depend
on?" with fewer rows than the truth — silently, with no flag that
could recover them, and about a LIVE item. There is deliberately no
opt-out: an item's edges are a property of the item being viewed, so
the honest default is to report every edge and say which ends are put
away. The item itself may be archived too (resolution is
[`Liveness::IncludeArchived`] since KAIROS-T-0154).

**The mark `done: true` shows a neighbour in a terminal column**
(COLLIERY-T-0214). Done work does not block, and nothing blocks done
work. A `blocks` edge with a done end is history, not a blocker. The
list keeps the edge: only the counts on the board change.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `entity_type` | path | yes | `string` | Plural family name (strategies|initiatives|tasks|documents|adrs) |
| `short_code` | path | yes | `string` | Item short code |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`ItemRelationshipsResponse`](../schemas/#itemrelationshipsresponse) | Both directions, grouped by relationship type |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown family or short code |

### `PATCH /api/{entity_type}/{short_code}/metadata`

Set/update/clear metadata values on an item.

The edit rule applies (COLLIERY-T-0228). The caller created the
item, holds `manage_<type>` on its authorization board, or is an organization admin.

Every entry is
validated BEFORE anything is written (A-0003: unknown slug and invalid
values are 422 `VALIDATION`); the writes then apply atomically. Each
value that changes writes one activity row (KAIROS-T-0557).

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `entity_type` | path | yes | `string` | Plural family name (strategies|initiatives|tasks|documents|adrs) |
| `short_code` | path | yes | `string` | Item short code |

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`UpdateMetadataRequest`](../schemas/#updatemetadatarequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`ItemMetadataResponse`](../schemas/#itemmetadataresponse) | The item's metadata after the update |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Refused by the edit rule: the caller did not create the item and lacks the capability |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown family or short code |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown definition slug or invalid value for its type |

## history

### `GET /api/{entity_type}/{short_code}/activity`

The activity of one item, newest first (KAIROS-T-0557).

Each row has the action, the stored details, and `text`. The text is
the row as one line. It names the people, the boards, the columns and
the repositories.

The list has moves, cancels, claims, hand-offs and releases. It also
has the lane, metadata values, state writes and links. A link between
two items is in the list of the two items. An archived item has its
activity too.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `entity_type` | path | yes | `string` | Plural family name (strategies|initiatives|tasks|documents|adrs) |
| `short_code` | path | yes | `string` | Item short code |
| `limit` | query | no | `integer` | Page size (default 50, max 200). |
| `offset` | query | no | `integer` | Rows to skip (default 0). |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`ListEnvelope_ItemActivityEntry`](../schemas/#listenvelope_itemactivityentry) | Page of the activity of the item, newest first |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown family or short code |

### `GET /api/{entity_type}/{short_code}/history`

snapshot with `?version=N`.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |

| `short_code` | path | yes | `string` | Item short code |
| `version` | query | no | `integer` | Return this version's full snapshot instead of the version list. |
| `limit` | query | no | `integer` | Page size for the version list (default 50, max 200). |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`ListEnvelope_HistoryVersion`](../schemas/#listenvelope_historyversion) | Version list envelope (or a HistorySnapshot with ?version=N) |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown family, short code, or version |

### `POST /api/{entity_type}/{short_code}/notes`

Append a note to an item. The note gets the next id (`n-3`), the time
and the caller as its author. The text is markdown, and it can have
headings. The note writes no version of the content: the read of the
item shows it in `notes`.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `entity_type` | path | yes | `string` | Plural family name (strategies|initiatives|tasks|documents|adrs) |
| `short_code` | path | yes | `string` | Item short code |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | no | `string`, nullable | Optional. A key that you choose for this write: 8 to 128 characters of letters, digits, '.', '_', ':' and '-' (a UUID is a good key). Send it when you may retry the request. For 24 hours, a request with the same key and the same arguments writes nothing and gives the first status and body again, with the header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. The same key with other arguments is refused with REQUEST_KEY_REUSED (KAIROS-A-0065). |

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`AppendNoteRequest`](../schemas/#appendnoterequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`AppendNoteResponse`](../schemas/#appendnoteresponse) | Appended; the id of the note and the version of the content, which does not change |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Refused by the edit rule: the caller did not create the item and lacks the capability |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown family or short code, or the item is archived |
| `409` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | REQUEST_KEY_REUSED: the Idempotency-Key was used for a different request |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | The text is empty, or the body has an unknown field |

### `POST /api/{entity_type}/{short_code}/notes/{note_id}/promote`

Turn a note into a draft ADR or document (KAIROS-T-0505). The new item
has the text of the note. A line names the note, its author and its
date. It `supports` the source item when the source is a
strategy, an initiative or a task. The note gets `promoted_to`: the
code of the new item. Kairos promotes a note one time only: a second
promote gets 409 CONFLICT, which names the item.

The edit rule of the source item applies. The caller needs the right
to create on the target board.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `entity_type` | path | yes | `string` | Plural family name (strategies|initiatives|tasks|documents|adrs) |
| `short_code` | path | yes | `string` | Item short code |
| `note_id` | path | yes | `string` | The id of the note, as `get_item` lists it (n-3) |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | no | `string`, nullable | Optional. A key that you choose for this write: 8 to 128 characters of letters, digits, '.', '_', ':' and '-' (a UUID is a good key). Send it when you may retry the request. For 24 hours, a request with the same key and the same arguments writes nothing and gives the first status and body again, with the header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. The same key with other arguments is refused with REQUEST_KEY_REUSED (KAIROS-A-0065). |

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`PromoteNoteRequest`](../schemas/#promotenoterequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | [`PromoteNoteResponse`](../schemas/#promotenoteresponse) | The new item and its edge |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Refused by the edit rule of the source item, or the caller cannot create on the target board |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown family, short code, note id or board |
| `409` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | The note has the mark of a promote; the refusal names the item; or REQUEST_KEY_REUSED: the Idempotency-Key was used for a different request |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | The kind is not adr or document, or the body has an unknown field |

## cascade

### `GET /api/{entity_type}/{short_code}/cascade-preview`

What an archive of this item BY THE CALLER would take, and what it
would leave (COLLIERY-T-0234), computed without deleting. An open
tenant-wide read: it names short codes, which each member can read.

The answer is for the caller who asks. It does not say whether the
caller may archive the item itself: `DELETE` checks that.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `entity_type` | path | yes | `string` | Plural family name (strategies|initiatives|tasks|documents|adrs) |
| `short_code` | path | yes | `string` | Item short code |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`CascadePreviewResponse`](../schemas/#cascadepreviewresponse) | What a soft-delete by the caller would cascade to (root excluded), and the live descendants that it would leave, matching the eventual DeleteResponse |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown family or short code |

## restore

### `POST /api/{entity_type}/{short_code}/restore`

Put an archived item back on its board.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `entity_type` | path | yes | `string` | Plural family name |
| `short_code` | path | yes | `string` | Item short code |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`RestoreResponse`](../schemas/#restoreresponse) | Restored |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Refused by the edit rule: the caller did not create the item and lacks the capability |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown short code, or the item is not archived |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Its board, column, team or repository is gone; details.missing names them |

## search

### `GET /api/items/{short_code}/proposals`

Pending edge proposals touching an item.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `short_code` | path | yes | `string` | The item |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | array of [`EdgeProposalDto`](../schemas/#edgeproposaldto) | Undecided proposals naming this item at either end, best-evidence first |
| `401` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Missing/invalid token |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | No item with that short code |

### `GET /api/items/{short_code}/related`

Related work for an item (KAIROS-A-0021 rules 5-7, KAIROS-T-0191).

A **separate surface**, deliberately. `/api/search` keeps its at-least-one
rule, its ≤5-query bound and its deterministic sort; callers relying on those
keep them, and nothing here changes what that endpoint does.

`GET` rather than `POST`, unlike `/api/search`: this takes one identifier and
is a read with no body, so it is cacheable and linkable and behaves the way a
reader expects.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `short_code` | path | yes | `string` | The item to find related work for |
| `limit` | query | no | `integer` | How many proposals (default 5, max 10) |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`RelatedWorkResponse`](../schemas/#relatedworkresponse) | Bounded proposals, best first. `vector: false` means a degraded, text-only answer rather than a wrong one |
| `401` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Missing/invalid token |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Not a member of the organization |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | No item with that short code |
| `503` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Embeddings are not enabled on this deployment |

### `POST /api/proposals/{id}/confirm`

Confirm a proposal, creating the edge.

The caller holds `approve_proposals` on the board of one end, or is an
organization admin (KAIROS-T-0659). A refused confirm leaves the
proposal pending.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | The proposal |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`EdgeProposalDto`](../schemas/#edgeproposaldto) | Confirmed; the relationship now exists |
| `400` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | The edge was refused by the graph's own rules — a cycle, or a shape the rule matrix forbids |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | FORBIDDEN: the caller holds approve_proposals on neither board and is not an organization admin; details.any_of names the board of each end |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | No such proposal |
| `409` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | CONFLICT: the proposal is decided already, also by a decision at the same time |

### `POST /api/proposals/{id}/reject`

Reject a proposal. Recorded, not erased.

The rule of who decides is the rule of the confirm (KAIROS-T-0659).

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | The proposal |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`EdgeProposalDto`](../schemas/#edgeproposaldto) | Rejected, and kept — a repeatedly rejected pair is the clearest signal that retrieval is wrong about something |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | FORBIDDEN: the caller holds approve_proposals on neither board and is not an organization admin; details.any_of names the board of each end |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | No such proposal |
| `409` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | CONFLICT: the proposal is decided already, also by a decision at the same time |

### `POST /api/search`

Unified search (KAIROS-A-0007): full-text `q`, structured `filter`, and
graph `traverse` compose freely; at least one must be present.

A hit is a card (KAIROS-T-0602). It has the title and a `snippet` of
the content near the match. It has no content. The item route of the
hit gives the content.

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`SearchRequest`](../schemas/#searchrequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`SearchResponse`](../schemas/#searchresponse) | Matches grouped by entity type (empty groups omitted); total counted before pagination |
| `400` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Invalid search request; details.field names the offending field |
| `401` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Missing/invalid token |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Not a member of the organization |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | traverse.from names no entity the request may see (unknown, or archived without filter.include_deleted) |
